visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit studio. He holds a vibrant orange iPhone 17 Pro Max towards the camera. The background features white shelves stocked with various books, action figures, and a decorative plush penguin. (2) A close-up shot transitions to the rear of the orange smartphone, highlighting its camera module and sleek texture while the man's hands firmly grip the sides. (3) The man is shown again from the waist up, speaking directly to the camera with an expressive face and gesturing with his right hand to emphasize points about the phone's hardware. (4) The scene cuts to a screen recording of the mobile game Genshin Impact, showing a character sprinting through a detailed fantasy city environment with virtual joysticks visible on the left and right. (5) A technical overlay appears, displaying a performance chart with red and green lines representing frame rate stability and temperature data. (6) The man returns to the screen, pointing a finger at the camera while holding the phone, looking confident and energetic. (7) The video transitions to a montage of a live K-pop concert, where several female dancers in white and gold outfits perform choreography on a stage under intense blue and white spotlighting. (8) A small picture-in-picture window appears in the corner showing the man's reaction as he records the concert footage, while the main frame shows the stage. (9) The man is back in the studio, holding the phone and looking slightly more contemplative while discussing the device's AI limitations. (10) A final close-up shows the phone screen plugged into a white USB-C cable, displaying a large charging icon and the battery percentage at 94%.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: iPhone 17 Pro Max 最速開箱!. (2) [Subtitle]: 各位我們已經第一時間. (3) [Subtitle]: 開箱實測完最新一代的. [Logo]: iPhone 17 Pro Max. (4) [Subtitle]: iPhone 17 Pro Max 我們來直接講重點喔. (5) [Subtitle]: 首先這一代因為加入了VC均熱板. (6) [Subtitle]: 所以遊玩重度遊戲的表現跟溫控非常的好. (7) [Variety]: 崩鐵30分鐘平均張數59張. (8) [Subtitle]: 崩鐵可以全程60張運行. (9) [Subtitle]: 再加上電量加大. (10) [Subtitle]: 你可以玩超過4個小時的崩鐵. (11) [Subtitle]: 比上一代多玩40分鐘. (12) [Subtitle]: 絕對是手遊黨的神器. (13) [Subtitle]: 那搭配了全新的1800萬畫素. [Variety]: 原況照片. (14) [Subtitle]: 更廣的前置鏡頭. (15) [Subtitle]: 很適合自媒體工作者使用. (16) [Slogan]: Shot on iPhone 17 Pro Max (距離舞台約30公尺). (17) [Subtitle]: 那這次全新的4800萬像素望遠鏡頭. (18) [Subtitle]: 搭配了40倍數位變焦. (19) [Subtitle]: 在望遠拍照還有錄影上也比上一代更加的有感提升. (20) [Subtitle]: 再加上這一代支援了前後鏡頭同時錄影. (21) [Variety]: (但不能分成兩個影片檔案). (22) [Subtitle]: 所以你終於可以把你在演唱會上尖叫模糊的臉跟明星的表演. (23) [Subtitle]: 錄在同一個畫面內. (24) [Subtitle]: 但如果是高倍數的錄影還是安卓旗艦機更強一點. (25) [Subtitle]: 所以要追求極致砲拍的人. (26) [Subtitle]: 建議還是要用S25 Ultra. (27) [Subtitle]: 而且充電也變快了. (28) [Subtitle]: 20分鐘就可以充滿50%. [Variety]: 充電中 94%. (29) [Subtitle]: 所以這一代的硬體改善幅度還是蠻有感的. (30) [Subtitle]: 可惜這一代的AI依舊是沒有追上安卓陣營. (31) [Subtitle]: 只能期待未來iOS軟體更新後可以慢慢跟上囉.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male vocal track in Traditional Chinese, exhibiting professional clarity and moderate pitch. A persistent, high-tempo electronic BGM with synthesized drums and a bright synth lead plays underneath. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition as the speaker's vocal tone shifts slightly to a technical narrative style, detailing performance stats. The electronic BGM maintains its driving rhythm. (3) A digital 'pop' SFX accompanies the appearance of on-screen graphics. The speaker's voice is well-projected with high arousal. (4) The acoustic atmosphere shifts dramatically as high-frequency crowd cheering and screaming are layered into the background, simulating a concert environment while the speaker's narration continues clearly. (5) The speaker concludes with a slightly lower pitch, reflecting a critical opinion on the phone's AI, before the BGM swells briefly and cuts hard at the final frame.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Technical Specs (Gaming) -> Camera Features -> Comparison with Competitor -> Battery -> Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide an immediate and comprehensive 'first impression' review of the iPhone 17 Pro Max, highlighting its gaming thermals, significant camera zoom upgrades, and fast charging while honestly critiquing its AI software relative to Android competitors.
